generationPrompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a reference for a hand-drawn SVG game piece in slotVend. Create exactly one perfectly round game counter viewed straight from above, truly transparent background. TWO-DIMENSIONAL editorial vector illustration, bold dark charcoal outer outline, slightly irregular hand-drawn charm, solid flat colours, one inset circular engraved ring, one small curved cream highlight, a simple offset dark lower rim for a little thickness. Like a beautifully printed board-game illustration, mature playful design. No photography, no realistic material texture, no wood grain, no rendering, no glossy 3D, no scene, no text, no faces, no sparkles. Centered and filling 80% of the canvas. Colour: warm coral orange, pale peach ring, dark terracotta lower rim.
